caption.instagram:
Your screen time isn't the real problem. Your pickups are.

Open Screen Time (iPhone) or Digital Wellbeing (Android). Find pickups, or unlocks. 90 a day x 2 minutes = 3 hours, gone in pieces.

Then scroll to "first used after pickup": the app your thumb opens before you've thought about it.

The pickup reset:
1. Move that one app off your home screen, into a folder on the last page
2. Turn off its notifications
3. Check your pickups again in 7 days

Send this to the friend who checks their phone mid-sentence.
